# Environment variables

<!-- Generated by `bun run gen:env:docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

All 62 of them, derived from the zod schemas in [`src/config/dto/`](../src/config/dto/)
by `scripts/gen-env-docs.ts` - so this table cannot drift from what actually
validates the environment at boot.

Bun loads `.env` and `.env.local` itself, so there is no loader and no `dotenv`.
A variable set in the real environment wins over both.

**Only `API_PORT` is strictly required.** Everything else has a default or is
genuinely optional, which is what makes `bun run start` work on a clean checkout
with nothing else running. Two variables become required conditionally, and both
are enforced by `superRefine` rather than by a field: `POSTGRES_URL` when
`DB_TYPE=postgres`, `S3_BUCKET` when `STORAGE_DRIVER=s3`, `REDIS_URL` when
`AUTH_SESSION_STORE=redis`, and `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` when `APP_ENV=prod`.

Two things to read correctly, both consequences of the table describing what you
**write** rather than what the app ends up holding:

- A boolean is `string` here, because that is what an environment variable is.
  `z.stringbool()` accepts `true`/`false`, `1`/`0`, `yes`/`no` and `on`/`off`, and
  every one of them defaults to `false` when unset. The default sits on the parsed
  side, so this column cannot show it.
- A comma-separated list is `string` too. `LOG_MASK_FIELDS` and
  `LOG_FILTER_EVENTS` parse `a, b ,c` into an array and fall back to a list spelled
  out in `src/config/dto/service-vars.dto.ts` when blank or absent.

## Service, logging and HTTP

Everything about the process itself. `API_PORT` is the only variable in the whole file with no default, so it is the only one that is strictly required.

| Variable                 | Type                                                      | Required | Default          | Notes |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------- | ----- |
| `APP_ENV`                | `local` · `dev` · `stage` · `prod`                        | no       | `"local"`        | -     |
| `NODE_ENV`               | `development` · `test` · `production`                     | no       | `"development"`  | -     |
| `LOG_LEVEL`              | `verbose` · `debug` · `info` · `warn` · `error` · `fatal` | no       | `"debug"`        | -     |
| `LOG_MASK_FIELDS`        | `string`                                                  | no       | -                | -     |
| `LOG_FILTER_EVENTS`      | `string`                                                  | no       | -                | -     |
| `LOG_REQUEST_BODY`       | `string`                                                  | no       | -                | -     |
| `LOG_RESPONSE_BODY`      | `string`                                                  | no       | -                | -     |
| `API_PORT`               | `integer` 0..65535                                        | **yes**  | -                | -     |
| `API_PREFIX`             | `string`                                                  | no       | `"api"`          | -     |
| `HEALTH_MAX_MEMORY_MB`   | `integer` min 16                                          | no       | `2048`           | -     |
| `SERVICE_COMMIT_SHA`     | `string`                                                  | no       | -                | -     |
| `SERVICE_COMMIT_MESSAGE` | `string`                                                  | no       | -                | -     |
| `CORS_ORIGIN`            | `string`                                                  | no       | `"*"`            | -     |
| `TRUST_PROXY`            | `string`                                                  | no       | -                | -     |
| `DOCS_PATH`              | `string`                                                  | no       | `"docs"`         | -     |
| `DOCS_JSON_PATH`         | `string`                                                  | no       | `"openapi.json"` | -     |
| `TZ`                     | `string`                                                  | no       | `"UTC"`          | -     |

## Database

SQLite by default and with no path to set. `DB_TYPE=postgres` is refused at boot: the data layer here is synchronous `bun:sqlite`, and `@dunx/infra/db` supports `Bun.SQL` perfectly well but this template does not use it.

| Variable         | Type                  | Required | Default           | Notes |
| ---------------- | --------------------- | -------- | ----------------- | ----- |
| `DB_TYPE`        | `sqlite` · `postgres` | no       | `"sqlite"`        | -     |
| `SQLITE_DB_PATH` | `string`              | no       | `"./data/app.db"` | -     |
| `POSTGRES_URL`   | `string`              | no       | -                 | -     |

## Redis, cache and rate limiting

All optional. With no `REDIS_URL` the cache reports itself degraded, the throttler stops counting and websocket fan-out stays local to the process.

| Variable                       | Type                   | Required | Default              | Notes |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------- | -------- | -------------------- | ----- |
| `REDIS_URL`                    | `string`               | no       | -                    | -     |
| `REDIS_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS`     | `integer` 50..30000    | no       | `500`                | -     |
| `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`            | `integer` 1..3600      | no       | `30`                 | -     |
| `THROTTLE_PREFIX`              | `string`               | no       | `"dunx-template"`    | -     |
| `THROTTLE_LIMIT`               | `integer` 1..10000     | no       | `20`                 | -     |
| `THROTTLE_WINDOW_SECONDS`      | `integer` 1..3600      | no       | `60`                 | -     |
| `QUEUE_PREFIX`                 | `string`               | no       | `"dunx-template"`    | -     |
| `QUEUE_MAX_RETRIES`            | `integer` 1..10        | no       | `3`                  | -     |
| `QUEUE_RETRY_DELAY_MS`         | `integer` 100..60000   | no       | `5000`               | -     |
| `QUEUE_CONCURRENCY`            | `integer` 1..100       | no       | `3`                  | -     |
| `QUEUE_RATE_LIMIT_MAX`         | `integer` 1..1000      | no       | `100`                | -     |
| `QUEUE_RATE_LIMIT_DURATION_MS` | `integer` 100..60000   | no       | `1000`               | -     |
| `QUEUE_JOB_TIMEOUT_MS`         | `integer` 1000..600000 | no       | `120000`             | -     |
| `WS_RELAY_CHANNEL`             | `string`               | no       | `"dunx-template:ws"` | -     |

## Storage and uploads

`STORAGE_DRIVER=local` writes through `Bun.file` and needs nothing. `s3` is `Bun.S3Client`, and credentials fall through to Bun’s own resolution when the `S3_*` variables are unset.

| Variable                | Type                | Required | Default            | Notes |
| ----------------------- | ------------------- | -------- | ------------------ | ----- |
| `STORAGE_DRIVER`        | `local` · `s3`      | no       | `"local"`          | -     |
| `STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT`    | `string`            | no       | `"./data/uploads"` | -     |
| `STORAGE_PREFIX`        | `string`            | no       | `(empty)`          | -     |
| `S3_BUCKET`             | `string`            | no       | -                  | -     |
| `S3_REGION`             | `string`            | no       | -                  | -     |
| `S3_ENDPOINT`           | `string`            | no       | -                  | -     |
| `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID`      | `string`            | no       | -                  | -     |
| `S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`  | `string`            | no       | -                  | -     |
| `UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES`      | `integer` min 1024  | no       | `10485760`         | -     |
| `UPLOAD_ALLOWED_TYPES`  | `string`            | no       | -                  | -     |
| `IMAGE_QUALITY`         | `integer` 1..100    | no       | `80`               | -     |
| `IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH`       | `integer` 16..20000 | no       | `2048`             | -     |
| `IMAGE_THUMBNAIL_WIDTH` | `integer` 16..2000  | no       | `256`              | -     |

## Authentication

`BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` is optional outside production and **mandatory when `APP_ENV=prod`** - the development fallback is a constant in this repository, so anyone holding it can mint a session.

| Variable                     | Type                 | Required | Default             | Notes |
| ---------------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | ------------------- | ----- |
| `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`         | `string` min 32      | no       | -                   | -     |
| `AUTH_SESSION_STORE`         | `database` · `redis` | no       | `"database"`        | -     |
| `WEB_URL`                    | `string`             | no       | -                   | -     |
| `AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS`       | `string`             | no       | -                   | -     |
| `AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRATION`    | `integer` 60..604800 | no       | `86400`             | -     |
| `AUTH_SESSION_UPDATE_AGE`    | `integer` 60..604800 | no       | `3600`              | -     |
| `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID`     | `string`             | no       | -                   | -     |
| `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` | `string`             | no       | -                   | -     |
| `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID`     | `string`             | no       | -                   | -     |
| `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` | `string`             | no       | -                   | -     |
| `SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL`           | `string`             | no       | `"admin@local.dev"` | -     |
| `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD`        | `string` min 8       | no       | `"admin-password"`  | -     |

## Notifications

With no `EMAIL_WEBHOOK_URL`, `EmailService` logs the message it would have sent. That is enough to prove the queue delivered a job to a worker.

| Variable            | Type                 | Required | Default | Notes                                                                          |
| ------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `EMAIL_WEBHOOK_URL` | `string (uri)`       | no       | -       | Where to POST an outbound email. Unset logs the message instead of sending it. |
| `EMAIL_TIMEOUT_MS`  | `integer` 100..60000 | no       | `5000`  | Per-attempt budget for the email webhook call.                                 |
| `EMAIL_MAX_RETRIES` | `integer` 0..5       | no       | `2`     | Retries inside one job attempt. The queue retries the job on top of this.      |
